title: Orbit Lesson
method: Native SVG schematic: orbital paths and central star, then stylized planets, arrows and hand-authored path labels.
limitations: Illustrative only and visibly labeled NOT TO SCALE. Planet sizes, distances and positions are invented; this is not a physical simulation or astronomical ephemeris.

notes: Orbital guides, stylized planets, rings, direction arrows and native-path labels match the original schematic. The NOT TO SCALE caption remains visible. Preview edge differences at 480x297 are below 0.13/255 mean absolute channel error. The illustration is not a physical simulation or astronomical ephemeris.

Inspected actual offline Chromium source/drawing/final preview plus opening/middle/final on light, dark and checkerboard backgrounds. Opening is blank without added blue decoration; exterior transparency and source-colored interior areas are preserved.
Inspected decoded GIF opening, drawing and final frames: 480x297, 41 stored frames, 4800 ms including final hold. The declared #F6F7FB GIF matte is opaque, while HTML and PNG retain exterior alpha.
Original outline colors are retained. Dark source outlines have lower contrast on dark test surfaces; the supplied light matte provides the intended presentation contrast.
